verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party npm/JS package that a web developer can import, bundle, and tree-shake as a dependency. What it does show is adjacent: the UPM registry delivers packages into the Unity Editor, WebGL is a build-export target, and Homebrew/CLI installs only fetch the Hub, Editor, or tooling. None of these install the engine as a library in an existing web toolchain.

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency
